items.prompt: Read and Answer 閱讀短文（Jenny's Busy Saturday），選出正確的答案
items.passage: Hi, I'm Jenny. I'm from Taiwan. Today is Saturday, and my family is busy. I go to the library by bike. My brother Ben goes to the park on foot. My mother goes to the bank by car, and my father goes to the post office by scooter. My cousin Kevin is from the USA. He comes to Taiwan by plane today! In the afternoon, my grandpa and I go to the airport by MRT to meet him.
items.correctEn: Answer: Taiwan
items.teacherText: 閱讀：Where is Jenny from? → Taiwan
